payload.text: The previous rework returned the same result tree and did not implement these test improvements. Please improve the tests within the current greeting specification. The test named test_no_network_or_filesystem_side_effects currently only compares two return values; that does not test the no-I/O requirement. Replace it with a meaningful guard that would fail if greeting attempts filesystem or network I/O. Also add regressions showing that Unicode surrounding whitespace is trimmed and that a decomposed name containing combining marks is preserved literally without normalization. Keep the same greeting behavior, same Node, standard-library-only dependencies, and exact documented test command. Preserve all existing repository files and README content. Run the documented tests and report the actual results.
